opinions.point: Many viewers praised the emotional character writing and considered the series highly satisfying overall.
Several commenters liked the focus on Ari and felt the episode handled her emotional development effectively.
Some viewers highlighted the show’s characters, voice acting, music, and emotional impact as major strengths.
A few viewers felt the episode was less like a conventional finale and more like an extra epilogue, while still appreciating its content.
Some commenters enjoyed the episode but felt it left substantial worldbuilding and future-story questions unresolved.
Many comments criticized Crunchyroll for failing to provide English subtitles promptly.
